name: Pasatiempo Golf Club
centre_source: Wikipedia 37°00′14″N 122°01′34″W (clubhouse area); OpenGolfAPI 37.0041546, -122.025981; address 20 Clubhouse Road, Santa Cruz, CA 95060
architects: Alister MacKenzie (1929; bunkers shaped by Robert Hunter and Paddy Cole)
Tom Doak with Jim Urbina (restoration, consulting from 1996; front nine 2005, back nine 2007)
Jim Urbina Golf Design (restoration 17 Apr 2023 - 5 Dec 2024)
renovations: Depression era: bunkers removed or altered, greens shrunk, tees moved (GolfPass 2009)

1996-2007: Tom Doak / Jim Urbina restoration; hole 12 first; front nine fall 2005, back nine fall 2007; >50 trees removed, 36 bunkers restored, greens enlarged 26,000 sq ft; 16th green enlarged; 17th green moved back ~45 ft

2023-04-17 to 2024-12-05: Jim Urbina; all greens rebuilt (Poa annua to bentgrass) and all bunkers rebuilt; front nine reopened Dec 2023, back nine closed May-Dec 2024; trees removed near 2, 3, 6 green, 15 green
notable: MacKenzie's home beside the 6th fairway (he died there in 1934)
Marion Hollins founded it; Bobby Jones played the opening day
video_games: PGA Championship Golf 1999 Edition (Sierra; Wikipedia course list); Tiger Woods PGA Tour 06 (Giant Bomb course list, Xbox 360)
tees_note: Ratings, slopes and totals from the club's website. Women's par 72 is from GolfPass (the club says only that the forward tees have their own par and stroke index). scorecard.csv's per-hole rows are from Stymie: White/Green adds to 5,780 and Green to 5,595 there.
theme: norcal (new Northern California theme shared with SFGC; reuse Cypress Point / Stanford's California theme if one lands first and its trees fit; distinct from the socal theme proposed for Pelican Hill / Strawberry Farms)
wind_note: proposed new band 'California coast, inland hills': about 4 km from Monterey Bay, hilly and wooded; afternoon bay sea breeze
special_ground: barrancas (brushy, wooded ravines on the back nine; staked penalty areas at 11, 16, 18; grassed gullies on 12, 13, 14)
water: virtually none in play; a stream in the barranca at 16; barranca penalty areas on 11 (lateral, B-2), 16 (short right of green) and 18 (yellow, drop zone)
